description.value: Library Hotel by Library Hotel Collection is a boutique hotel at 299 Madison Ave, at E.41st Street New York City 10017. Guests get access to our collection of over 6,000 books, and refreshments are available 24 hours a day in our Reading Room. The hotel sits a block from the New York Public Library and Grand Central.
